home.capabilitiesTitle: An operating layer for serious AI work
home.capabilitiesCopy: The interface reflects capabilities present in the current AIONEX AIOS repository without invented performance claims or customer figures.
home.capability1Copy: Route work through specialized agents, governed workflows, quality gates, and approval-aware execution.
home.capability2Copy: Coordinate model providers, compare outputs, and support consensus-oriented decision paths.
home.capability3Copy: Apply role permissions, owner policies, audit context, limits, and operational safeguards.
home.capability4Copy: Connect project delivery to distributed runtime, monitoring, recovery, memory, and knowledge services.

about.title: AIONEX AIOS is built to make intelligent execution governable
about.description: It brings project work, agents, models, memory, security, owner controls, and operational services into a coherent system rather than isolated tools.
about.missionCopy: Help teams move from intent to reliable AI-assisted delivery while keeping authority, limits, approvals, and evidence visible.
about.visionCopy: An extensible operating layer where intelligent systems can collaborate without removing human and organizational control.
about.principlesTitle: Control is part of the architecture
about.principle1Copy: Identity, permissions, auditability, and safe operational boundaries are first-class concerns.
about.principle2Copy: Availability, limits, service access, and sensitive actions remain subject to owner policy.
about.principle3Copy: Planning, execution, review, and recovery paths are structured so decisions remain understandable.
about.principle4Copy: Agents, providers, infrastructure, memory, and integrations can evolve behind stable interfaces.
about.scopeTitle: This site is the public and account entry point
about.scopeCopy: It introduces AIONEX AIOS, provides real account access and owner-governed registration, and connects authenticated users to their profile and project data. The broader operating system remains in the existing platform.

legal.privacyIntro: This notice describes processing performed by the AIONEX AIOS account interface and the registration information required by the platform.
legal.privacy1Copy: Registration sends the name, username, email, date of birth, declared country, international mobile number, consent version, and—when required—a Firebase identity token to AIONEX AIOS.
legal.privacy2Copy: When platform policy requires it, the interface sends available browser, device-capability, language, timezone, network-quality, and referrer signals for identity protection, quota enforcement, audit context, and abuse prevention.
legal.privacy3Copy: Authentication tokens are stored in browser storage for the active session flow. Uploaded profile images are converted to a data URL and sent through the protected service; supported formats and the 2 MB limit are enforced by the platform.
legal.privacy4Copy: Authenticated support requests are stored in the platform and delivered to authorized recipients. Never include passwords, session tokens, recovery codes, or unnecessary personal data.
legal.termsIntro: These interface terms explain the technical conditions enforced by the current platform. Organization-specific legal terms remain subject to the owner’s approved policy and must not be inferred from this site.
legal.terms1Copy: Use the service only through your own account and within the role, permissions, workspace scope, and limits assigned by the owner.
legal.terms2Copy: Provide accurate registration details, protect your credentials, complete required mobile verification, and never share access or refresh tokens.
legal.terms3Copy: Registration availability, quotas, service access, project limits, and other operational controls are enforced by the platform and may change.
legal.terms4Copy: Use the authenticated support channel for suitable requests and never disclose passwords, session tokens, recovery codes, or confidential content.
